  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Up for your consideration is this 2019 Toyota Highlander SE Nightshade AWD finished in stunning Midnight Black Metallic, a sharp and highly sought-after 3-row SUV that perfectly blends Toyota s legendary reliability, strong V6 performance, family-friendly versatility, and sporty styling. This is not your average Highlander the SE Nightshade Edition gives this SUV a much more aggressive and premium look with exclusive blacked-out styling throughout.

Powered by Toyota s proven 3.5L DOHC V6 producing 295 horsepower, paired with Toyota s smooth 8-speed automatic transmission and Dynamic Torque Control All-Wheel Drive, this Highlander delivers strong acceleration, confident highway passing power, and excellent all-weather capability. Whether you re hauling the family, heading into the mountains, towing toys, or just commuting, this Highlander is built to handle it all with confidence. It also offers an impressive 5,000-pound towing capacity.

One of the biggest highlights on this Highlander is the clean history. CARFAX shows no accidents or damage reported, no structural damage, no airbag deployment, no odometer issues, and no open recalls, giving buyers outstanding peace of mind. Clean Highlanders with this kind of history are exactly what buyers hunt for.

The Nightshade Edition package really sets this SUV apart, adding black badging, black window trim, black exterior door handles, black rear spoiler, black antenna, black mirror caps, black rear Toyota emblem, and black trunk garnish, creating an aggressive murdered-out look that makes this Highlander stand out from every standard model on the road. Toyota nailed the styling on these.

Inside, this Highlander came loaded with premium features including leather-trimmed front and second-row seats, heated front seats, 12-way power driver seat, 4-way power passenger seat, seating for 7, third-row 60/40 split-fold seating, integrated second-row sunshades, power moonroof, power liftgate with flip-up rear window, 3-zone automatic climate control, blind spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, smart key with push-button start, backup camera, navigation, and Toyota Safety Sense P with pre-collision braking, lane departure alert, adaptive radar cruise control, and automatic high beams. This is exactly the kind of equipment package families love.

This Highlander also came with desirable factory upgrades including all-weather floor liners, cargo liner, roof rack cross bars, and third-row all-weather mats, making it even better suited for Pacific Northwest living, road trips, sports gear, pets, and messy kids.

CARFAX shows 6 documented service records and all 3 owners were Washington owners, another big plus for local buyers. The first owner leased it and maintained it through Toyota of Olympia with regular 5k, 10k, and 15k services completed. A fuel pump replacement was also completed at Toyota of Puyallup, which is a nice major item to already have handled. The second owner continued servicing through Toyota of Tacoma with maintenance inspection, oil change, and tire rotation. Even better, CARFAX places this Highlander in the Top 25% for reliability compared to similar vehicles, with low likelihood of repair and below-average repair costs expected moving forward.

With just 30,985 miles, this Highlander has exceptionally low mileage for a 2019 model and has been driven far below the national average. Low-mileage, clean-history, AWD Highlanders especially Nightshade Editions are becoming increasingly difficult to find because buyers know these SUVs routinely run for hundreds of thousands of miles when properly maintained.

The Toyota Highlander continues to dominate the midsize SUV segment because it offers something few vehicles can match legendary reliability, excellent resale value, true 3-row practicality, strong V6 performance, and low long-term ownership costs. If you ve been searching for a clean, loaded, low-mileage family SUV that checks nearly every box, this Highlander does exactly that.

No matter your credit situation, we work with local credit unions, banks, and lenders to help get you approved even if your credit isn t perfect. Every vehicle on our lot goes through a complete ASE-certified inspection by a trusted third-party shop, followed by a fresh oil change, new filters, and a full detail before it s offered for sale. Certified, bold, and built with a rugged edge, this **2025 Kia Seltos X‑Line AWD** in eye‑catching Mars Orange delivers standout style, upgraded capability, and everyday practicality in a compact SUV that’s anything but basic. Powered by a responsive I4 engine paired with a smooth **8‑speed automatic transmission** and intelligent all‑wheel drive, it provides confident performance and traction for Colorado conditions while still staying efficient for daily driving.

Inside, the Black interior with **artificial leather trim** brings a refined yet durable feel, complemented by **heated front seats (3‑stage)**, a leather‑wrapped steering wheel, and a smart, functional layout designed for comfort and versatility. Technology is right where you want it with **Apple CarPlay and Android Auto**, built‑in **navigation**, a rearview camera, and an intuitive infotainment system that keeps everything simple and connected on every drive.

Safety features include **lane departure warning**, **blind spot monitoring**, electronic stability control, and a full airbag system to give you confidence behind the wheel. On the outside, the X‑Line trim brings an aggressive look with **18" gloss black alloy wheels**, bold accents, and unique styling that makes this Seltos stand out from the crowd. Practical upgrades like the **lifestyle hitch** and reversible cargo tray add real utility, making it ready for both daily errands and weekend adventures.

As a **Kia Certified vehicle**, this Seltos X‑Line AWD comes backed with outstanding peace of mind, including a **10‑year/100,000‑mile limited powertrain warranty from original in‑service date** and **1‑year/12,000‑mile Platinum Coverage** starting at purchase. Every Kia CPO goes through a **164‑point inspection**, and you also get **24/7 roadside assistance, towing coverage, rental car benefits, travel protection, and a complimentary CARFAX report**.

Unique in color, loaded with the right features, and built with AWD confidence, this **2025 Seltos X‑Line AWD** is the perfect mix of style, function, and value—and it stands out in all the right ways.

The Land Rover Range Rover (L405), generally shortened to Range Rover, is a mid-size to full-size luxury 4x4 / sport utility vehicle,[5] made under the Land Rover brand by Jaguar Land Rover. It is the fourth generation of the original, main Range Rover series. It uses an all-aluminium monocoque unitary body structure, instead of the third generation's steel unibody — making it the first production 4x4 to do so, resulting in a weight reduction of 420 kg (926 lb) compared to its predecessor. The vehicle was unveiled at the 2012 Paris Motor Show.[6] Sales of Range Rover began in late 2012 as 2013 models.
